connector.name: Costkits MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for CostKits: live healthcare procedure cost estimates and provider pricing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package costkits-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the costkits account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: COSTKITS_API_KEY
env.description: Your CostKits API key (ck_...). Required for all tools except demo_estimate.

env.name: COSTKITS_API_BASE
env.description: Override the CostKits API base URL (for testing).
